description: A screenshot request should select the screenshot domain's capture_screen with the given output path. Selection-only on purpose: a real capture needs the Screen Recording permission, which an unattended CI pass cannot grant, so this case does NOT assert tool_succeeds or a created file (that file-created check lives in the manual smoke list). It only proves the model routes to the screenshot tool rather than, say, a shell capture.
prompt: Take a screenshot and save it to /tmp/mcp-eval-shot-{{unique}}.png.

description: A request to grab a specific rectangle of the screen should route to the screenshot domain's capture_region (not the whole-desktop capture_screen). Selection-only: a real capture needs the Screen Recording permission CI cannot grant, so this asserts routing only, not a created file (that lives in the manual smoke list).
prompt: Take a screenshot of just the 400x300 region starting at the top-left corner (x=0, y=0) and save it to /tmp/mcp-eval-region-{{unique}}.png.

description: A request to screenshot a specific app's window should route to the screenshot domain's capture_window. Selection-only: a real capture needs Screen Recording + Accessibility + Automation grants CI cannot provide, so this asserts routing only.
prompt: Take a screenshot of the Safari window and save it to /tmp/mcp-eval-window-{{unique}}.png.
